extends: Completed WL65 Phase A (clean_v1.json, STOP_INSUFFICIENT_PRECISION). clean_v1.json, its 832 packets, labels, analysis and verdict are preserved unchanged; this is a separate prospectively declared extension.
authorisation: User brief 2026-10-31: one fixed reference top-up, conditional matched Noisy/Clean A/B, independent evaluation. No new architecture, no repeated top-up, no successor.

phase_A.identity_check: Rehash all 832 packets against their Phase-A receipts and all 26 label/variance bank files against labels_manifest.json before any new photon; any mismatch is STOP_INVALID_REFERENCE.

topup.seed_formula: 660000000 + pose_index*100000 + field_id*100 + replica*10 + k, k=0..5 (disjoint from Phase A 650000000-range, WL64 640000000-range, WL59 599000000-range)
topup.estimator: Identical to Phase A: unchanged WL59 incident-field-importance first-exit action and validated fast walker via moments65.observed_action; one field per call, its own RGB-mean proposal; no source/walker/path/sink/RNG change; same frozen source hashes; same physical packet checks.
topup.fixed: Population, photon count, chunk and seeds fixed before any new outcome. No field selection, count adjustment, replacement or second top-up after outcomes.

combination.replica_groups: Group r = Phase-A replica r halves {h0,h1} + top-up replica r packets {k0..k5}: 8 packets / 256M photons per group for fields 84-87; Phase-A fields keep 2 packets / 64M per group.
combination.mean: sum_i w_i m_i with w_i = N_i / sum N (float64 accumulation in fixed packet order; for equal N this is Phase A's mean exactly)
combination.variance_of_mean: sum_i w_i^2 v_i, v_i = per-packet variance of mean from aggregated first/second moments (aggregate exclusive bins BEFORE variance)
combination.replica_mean: count-weighted mean within each replica group; conservative noise = (group0-group1)/sqrt(2) as in Phase A
combination.covariance: Independent packets/fields/geometries: variances add. delta = current - rest: Var = Var_current + Var_rest (independent streams). Shared rest across dents: Cov(delta_g, delta_h) = Var(rest), cancels in delta_g - delta_h. RGB correlated; no iid-cell significance claim.
combination.bank: Combined 16-field bank: fields 80-83, 88-95 must equal Phase-A bank bitwise; fields 84-87 = combined 512M-photon mean. Original Phase-A bank files remain unchanged.

gates.population: All 624 absolute, 312 directional and 576 delta coarse cells of the complete 13x16 bank; no cell, field or geometry removed
gates.physical: All 624 new packets: exact budget, finite nonnegative, AO physical_passed, observer response/second-moment equality, no leak/truncation; identical frozen estimator source hashes
gates.identity: All Phase-A packet/bank hashes, original source/input/geometry identities (run65.manifest) re-verified unchanged
gates.semantic_consistency: For the 52 top-up actions: D = ||m_PhaseA - m_topup||^2 / (trV_PhaseA + trV_topup) per pose/field/channel at coarse aggregation; median over 156 cells must lie in [0.67, 1.5] (gross estimator mismatch only). Otherwise STOP_INVALID_REFERENCE.

precision_projection.prospective_only: Computed before generation from Phase-A deformation_all.csv assuming SE halves with 4x photons on current and rest and the bias-corrected weak-delta norm shrinks accordingly.
precision_projection.warning: Marginal: the worst projected cell (tr03 field85 B) sits at 0.249 against 0.25. A realised failure is possible and would be STOP, not a reason to add photons.

independent_population.name: U65 (uninspected)
independent_population.generator: unchanged r57_data.light_fields(rest geometry,64,6508103,'test'); retain indices 48:64 (8 equal-flux directional pairs)
independent_population.disjoint: sha256 of every field disjoint from WL57 train/validation/test and from WL64 independent fields
independent_population.estimator: WL63 observational tagged_action (T/B/Scat) on the unchanged first-exit action, as WL64
independent_population.qualification: all 24 total contrast pair/channel cells SNR>=3 for full confirmation; otherwise limited, no extra sampling
independent_population.timing: Generated and qualified only after Gate 2 READY and before any A/B training. Evaluation-only: never enters training, label construction, checkpoint selection or loss calibration.

historically_inspected: Original pt0 test Pair7 (fields 62/63) and its WL63 tagged components
Original pt0 primary pairs 0-7 (informed WL60-64 decisions)

ab.runner: Original WL59 train.py, evaluate.py, cost.py and run.sh executed unmodified from the frozen ~/rest_persist_v1/repo copy, resource policy 0 (WL57_ACTION_CHUNK=32000000, WL57_EDGE_CHUNK=65536, WL57_EVAL_BATCH=4, default microbatch 2), each arm in its own root.
ab.A: data -> original ~/rest_persist_v1/data; training_targets = original r0 for all 96 fields
ab.B: training_targets: for rest + 12 train dents, train[80:96] replaced by the qualified combined bank; train[0:80] and validation tensors byte-identical original; va0/va1 targets are the original files. Every evaluation input (geometry, lights, test targets) is the original file.
ab.identical: Model class/157,024 parameters, init torch.manual_seed(seed), field schedule numpy default_rng(574001), geometry schedule TRAIN[1+step%12], AdamW .003/wd1e-5, cosine to 3e-5, clip 1, action + .25 deformation objective, 6000 steps, final checkpoint, seeds 5901/5902, FP32 TF32 off
ab.order: seed 5901: A then B; seed 5902: B then A (alternated, serial, no GPU contention)
ab.no_reuse: Historical WL59/WL64 checkpoints are not reused as arms; A is retrained in the same runner.

controls.label_isolation: Per B file: keys identical; train[:80] and validation torch.equal original; train[80:96] torch.equal bank v2; A training_targets resolve to the protocol-hashed originals
controls.schedule: Final progress.pt numpy_rng state identical across arms per seed and equal to an independent reconstruction of 6000 steps of default_rng(574001).integers(0,96,2)
controls.optimizer: Final optimizer param_group hyperparameters identical across arms; checkpoints report steps 6000 and 157,024 parameters
controls.A_reproduction: Per seed, A versus preserved WL59 out/heldout.json: max absolute drift <= 2e-3 over every directional pair error, static coarse/fine16 mean and p90, and dynamic error/corr/slope (all poses, F and S); identical eligible F/S, useful_and_physical and pt0 qualified directional failure counts. Failure = outcome D.
controls.physical: Unchanged WL59 zero/linearity/nonnegative/passive/cache and F/S checks plus WL64-style trained rigid/no-op checks for every checkpoint

decisions.metric: Total-response directional relative L2 per pair/channel (WL59 definition)
decisions.primary: pt0 F-policy original 8 pairs x RGB, cells detectable in both arms: per seed B_mean/A_mean <= 0.90 and B qualified failures (>0.25) <= A
decisions.uninspected: U65 all-24 total-contrast mean error per seed B/A <= 0.90 (requires full U65 qualification, else INCONCLUSIVE)
decisions.regression: B/A >= 1.10 on primary or U65 in either seed
decisions.secondary_reported: Old pairs 0-6, WL64 independent population, Pair7 T/B/Scat, per-channel/per-pair cells, signed deformation, static, F/S, physics, costs, training/validation histories
decisions.outcome_A: Gate 2 READY, controls valid, primary AND uninspected improvement in both seeds
decisions.outcome_B: Gate 2 READY, controls valid, not A (sub-label: regression if the regression rule fires, otherwise no meaningful/mixed benefit)
decisions.outcome_C: Gate 2 not READY because of precision: no training
decisions.outcome_D: A/B uninterpretable: identity/semantic/physical-reference failure, label isolation, schedule/optimizer divergence, A reproduction failure or irreparable physical invariant failure
decisions.complete_K: Separately: every original WL59 static/dynamic/directional/reference/physics/F-S gate for both seeds and policies. A directional gain alone is not complete K.

prohibited: No gate relaxation, field removal, second top-up, model-family/capacity/loss/optimizer/step/distribution change, hyperparameter tuning, checkpoint selection, WL64 contrast term, F/S or C optimisation, coupled GI with ineligible K, or automatic successor.
